sentences.en: He has his personal bank account and she has hers.
sentences.zh: 1. 他有自己的个人银行账户，她有她的。

sentences.en: Sami's mother was bleaching his hair blond to match hers.
sentences.zh: 2. 萨米的母亲把他的头发漂成了金色，以匹配她的。

sentences.en: Jane lent me this book of hers last week.
sentences.zh: 3. 简上周借给我的是她的书。
